Midsummer brings a smooth week
Bravo to the whole team
Steady care at the companion desk

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways kept routines calm, clear, and kind, with handlers using humane methods and a welcome team helping passengers feel ready for boarding. Travel guidance remained concise and actionable, so travelers could follow each step with confidence and pets could stay settled through the process. The staff listened closely, answered practical concerns, and kept every handoff gentle and orderly.

This week also showed how well good preparation supports a smooth journey. When the desk offers plain direction and respectful attention, travelers are better able to focus on their plans and on the comfort of their animals. That steady approach reflects well on Aurelia Skyways and gives every pet a safer, calmer experience. Companion Animal Travel Desk
